doc.title: Ellen Rowe interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 2, 2024

title: Worst gigs: the bowling alley and the car lot
summary: Rowe recalls club dates at Eastman with a bandleader who vanished, including an electric piano gig in a bowling alley and one in a used-car lot.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: Can you remember your worst gig ever?

It’s a toss up between the one in the bowling alley or the one in the used car rental parking lot. And I think it was the same band leader on both. But you know — rest in peace — but yeah I think I did a lot of club dates when I was at Eastman, as did my peers. And we had a band leader who would send us out to all these strange places, and he would turn up for a little bit of each gig and then vanish to go on to the next one. And I just remember that the people who had hired him were always angry because they’d come up and say, “Where has he gone?” And I won’t even mention his name, but — and we’d say, “Oh gosh yeah, I don’t know.” But yeah one of those gigs he booked some kind of party where — playing electric piano in a bowling alley, and the other one was outdoors in a used car dealership outside in the parking lot.
I just got this image, you know you portrayed the sound of two tennis players briefly, I wonder if you could do that with a bowling alley.
Okay, you’ve got me thinking. That’s going to — that’s a challenge I may not be able to turn down. Pins going down. That’s going to be interesting.
Pins going down, ten of them now.
